more_info.origin: Made by esterifying tartaric acid with commercial stearyl alcohol. The alcohol mixture also contains palmityl alcohol.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
more_info.overview: Stearyl tartrate is classified in food technology as an emulsifier. Its technological role is to help oil and water stay mixed.
